profile.headline: PHP Developer
profile.summary: I specialize in the development of database driven applications and services for mobile and web. I have over a decade of experience in the LAMP environment with expertise in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS, LESS and HTML. I'm also branching out into Node, React and React Native where I hope to transition to native mobile development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a SaaS application providing SMS and general mobile marketing services. Features included automated text messaging, TCPA compliant opt-in process, URL shortening, tablet kiosks and mobile coupons.

Played a strong role in back-end development: database schema and abstraction layer, websocket service, SMS service, secure session management, multiple API development and integreations and all key products. Responsible for all front-end UI development.

Primary Back-End Technologies: PHP, MySQL, Apache, Linux.
Primary Front-End Technologies: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, LESS.

positions.title: Owner, Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Here I employ all of my traditional web development knowledge such as HTML, CSS and AJAX, as well as strong UI-database driven development knowledge in PHP, SQL and jQuery.  Combine with a heavy dose of video game programming and a dash of graphic design experience and you've got interactive and rich browser-based game experience.

In 2 Out Rally, users create and develop unique baseball players based on biographical detail and 12 critical game skills which determine how they play on the field each night when the simulations are run.  These players may be recruited, drafted, or traded into user managed teams to compete in an expandable league structure separated into various tiers to accommodate different levels of interest and competition.

Primary Back-End Technologies: PHP, MySQL, Apache, Linux.
Primary Front-End Technologies: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: Working with CLECs and local directory publishing companies to coordinate the listings for ported VOIP customers. Automating the update process for directory publishing across thousands of directories.

positions.description: Coordinating and publishing inter-office department web pages.
